name: breakpoint-canvas
label: BFB Breakpoint Canvas
lives: A builder tool, not an element: a button in the Bricks builder's toolbar (and Shift + B) that shows every breakpoint of the page side by side. It adds no control to any element and nothing to a page; its defaults are the WordPress option `bfbe_breakpoint_canvas`, set on its own page in the menu (BFB Elements, Breakpoint Canvas).
